reason: Part check PASS on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator test, PCB DRC clean, footprint, LCSC). The sim encodes the signed 24-bit result at 0x12 as V x 128 x 2^24 / 3.0 V (datasheet full scale +/-0.5 VREF/gain); read-only PUR/CR/CALS status bits are modelled with a 'Chip busy' toggle (inputBits) so the datasheet power-up, calibration and data-ready polling in the driver works unchanged.
